record.hypothesis: Across all four categories, add a projected causal prefix-mean log-frequency feature computed from training-only item counts. For embedding representation, initialize the tied item table with Normal(0,0.02), retaining a zero padding row, to remove vocabulary-size-dependent Xavier scale. For architecture, add a learned identity-initialized bilinear projection of encoded states before all target dot products. Jointly set maxlen=64, four blocks, dropout=0.1 and LR=5e-4. Prefix context and bilinear compatibility provide adaptability while the shallower backbone and lower LR control cost and scale drift. Preserve pointwise loss and final-real-position readout; serialize all changes in one model/category with matching predictor code and fixed training caps.

category_rationales.rationale: Add a learned projection of causal prefix-mean normalized log frequency, using counts from training interactions only. Persist the frequency buffer in each category's single checkpoint; the predictor imports the same architecture.

Jointly use a 64-item window, four causal convolution blocks, dropout 0.1 and learning rate 5e-4. The shorter, shallower network controls computation while lower dropout and learning rate support learning the new feature and compatibility projection. Existing metadata supplies predictor dimensions.

Apply one jointly trained identity-initialized bilinear projection to encoded states before every training and candidate dot product. Preserve causal convolutions, pointwise loss and final-real-position readout.
Initialize the tied input/output item table with Normal(0,0.02), keeping padding zero. This removes vocabulary-size dependence from its initial scale across the four datasets.
